verses.1: And in the days to come, the Mountain of God will be situated at the top of the mountains. It will be lifted up from its base, and nations will flow upon it.
verses.2: And many nations went and said, “Go up to the mountain of Jehovah, to the house of God where Jacob dwells. Follow his ways, and walk in his paths. For from Zion shall come salvation, and the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.”
verses.3: And he judged between many nations. He showed the nations their own ruins, and their cities became mere ruins. No nation could go from one ruined city to another, nor could they learn anything from those ruins.
verses.4: And they shall sit under their wings and under their bodies. And there will be no one who can separate them from the words of Jehovah, the Almighty.
verses.5: For all the nations will go away in the name of their gods. But we will go away in the name of the LORD our God, forever and ever.
verses.6: On that day, the Lord will gather together those who are rejected and neglected. I will bring them back to life.
verses.7: And I have placed the throne there forever, and it will be a place of rule for that nation. The king of Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from now on until eternity.
verses.8: And you, from Gedaliah of Mizpah, will be the first ruler over Jerusalem. You will reign as queen over the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.9: Now, why do you complain? My king, there’s no need for you to worry. I will protect you, just as a mother protects her child.
verses.10: Hulie vaghi, daughter of Zion! You were born just now. You have now left Kiriya and taken refuge in the field. Now you have come to Babylon. There you will be saved. There, Jehovah will deliver you from all your enemies.
verses.11: And now, many nations will gather around you. They will say, “Let us besiege and capture you in Zion.”
verses.12: And they did not know the thoughts of the LORD, nor did they understand His counsel. For He had appointed them as a reproach to all nations.
verses.13: Come and stand before Zion! Your horns will be placed in brass, and your branches will be covered with gold. I will strengthen you among many nations. I will make you strong for the Lord, your God, over all the earth.
verses.14: Now, let me describe the judgment that will be imposed upon us by those who sit on the throne. They will judge Israel with fairness.
